newsitem.title: USA: Tupperware sees lower Q2 sales, profit.
newsitem.headline: Tupperware sees lower Q2 sales, profit.

text.p: Tupperware Corp expects sales and profits for the second quarter to be lower than the same period last year as it struggles to improve business in the United States, the company said Monday.

"Excluding the impact of foreign exchange, the outlook for the second quarter is for sales to be down modestly and for profits to be down significantly mainly," it said. "It is taking longer than we expected to improve the U.S. business."
The company said it also foresaw a "mid-single digit sales increase, but a modest profit decrease" for the entire year.
Tupperware, which makes molded plastic storage products, reported a profit of $0.40 a share for the first quarter against $0.46 for the same period last year.
"We are disappointed with our start this year," it said.
"But we believe our strategies are correct and we will continue to focus on building our sales force, developing new products and geographic expansion."
